name: Morten Schenk
biography: Morten Schenk (@blomster81) is a security advisor and researcher at Improsec ApS, with a background in penetration testing, red teaming and exploit development. Having a high craving for learning and torture based on taking certifications like OSCP, OSCE and OSEE, Morten's research is specifically focused on binary exploitation and mitigation bypasses on Windows. He blogs about his research at https://improsec.com/blog/ @Blomster81
